name: wind-energy-simulator
description: Interactive 3D wind and solar energy simulator for university physics and renewable energy demonstrations

scripts.models:solar: node scripts/segment-solar.mjs --extract 1 --out public/models/solar-auto.glb && node scripts/segment-solar.mjs --extract 2 --out public/models/solar-manual.glb && node scripts/segment-solar.mjs --extract 4 --out public/models/solar-fixed.glb
scripts.models: npm run models:optimize && npm run models:small && npm run models:solar
scripts.verify: npm run verify:physics && npm run verify:solar
